newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc benefits from dollar weakness.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc benefits from dollar weakness.

text.p: 1530 GMT - The Swiss franc ended higher after the dollar came under pressure following comments from Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke, who said he was happy with the dollar's current levels but did not wish to see it move much higher.
The franc followed the move in dollar/mark and now, after its break down below 1.4650 to the dollar, the franc could mount a test of 1.4550, one dealer said.
But the franc was weaker versus sterling after the new UK finance minister announced an interest rate increase.
